sources.title: Glenn Flierl and Raffaele Ferrari, MIT OpenCourseWare 12.820, Turbulence in the Ocean and Atmosphere, Chapter 3 (Spring 2006 lecture notes)
sources.locator: Complete 11-page Chapter 3 PDF, §§3.1–3.8; especially §3.2 (joint moments and covariance, pp. 4–5), §3.6 (closure problem, pp. 8–9), and §3.7 (Reynolds equations, pp. 9–10).

contents.name: §3.1 Probability density functions and moments
contents.reason: The assigned items use finite deterministic weighted sums and make no probability-density, integrability, or asymptotic moment claim.

contents.name: §3.2 Joint probability density functions and covariance
contents.support: The source defines covariance through joint moments; the local definition states the exact finite normalized-weight tensor and its pointwise field convention.

contents.name: §3.3 Ergodicity and statistical symmetries
contents.reason: No ergodicity, stationarity, homogeneity, isotropy, or equivalence of ensemble and time averages is assumed or concluded.

contents.name: §3.4 Central Limit Theorem
contents.reason: The batch proves finite algebraic identities and constructs a finite counterexample; it makes no large-sample distributional claim.

contents.name: §3.5 Intermittency
contents.reason: No probability-density shape, intermittency measure, or empirical turbulence classification is part of the assigned mathematical scope.

contents.name: §3.6 Closure problem
contents.support: The source explains why the covariance is not deducible from the mean alone; the B item gives and verifies an explicit finite pair of periodic solution ensembles.

contents.name: §3.7 Reynolds equations
contents.support: The source develops the mean momentum equation and covariance term under statistical averaging; the local theorem proves the exact finite weighted identity without steady, ergodic, or limiting assumptions.

contents.name: §3.8 Eddy viscosity and eddy diffusivity
contents.reason: The assigned items define no closure law and assert no constitutive relation between covariance and mean gradients.

contents.name: (B) Reynolds averaging: long-time, finite-window, and ensemble conventions
contents.reason: The assigned definition uses fixed finite deterministic weights, not a stationary long-time limit, an intermediate time window, or a probability measure on solution trajectories.

contents.name: Reynolds-averaged Navier–Stokes mean-momentum equation and Reynolds stress
contents.support: Provides an independent statistical-average treatment of the mean momentum equation and covariance term; the local theorem proves the fixed finite-weight version pointwise.

contents.name: Mean-field kinetic-energy balance with stress-transfer term
contents.support: Displays the mean energy transfer contraction with the Reynolds covariance; the local proof derives its exact sign from periodic integration by parts.

contents.name: Reynolds-stress and turbulent kinetic-energy balance
contents.support: The trace balance places the same production term in the fluctuation budget with opposite sign; the local proof establishes this cancellation for the finite smooth family.

contents.name: Mean-vorticity and enstrophy balances
contents.reason: No vorticity, enstrophy, or filtered-transport equation is among the assigned claims.

contents.name: Filtering and wall-applicability discussion
contents.reason: The batch makes no filtering, wall-boundary, or large-eddy simulation claim; its integration domain is periodic.
